description: Every part a governed repository gets from Toolkit, on the repository, on each controller's computer and on the Claude Projects side, and how each follows Toolkit main after a release. repo/tests/governed-repository-inventory.test.cjs fails when a default cloud workflow, a file a refresh may change or a governance check finding has no row here, so a part added later cannot be left without a way to follow main.

follows.run-time: Runs Toolkit main on every run; no pull request is needed for a script change.
follows.refresh: Reaches the repository only through the refresh pull request (toolkit-cloud-workflows.cjs --refresh-pr). The controller's session start and the cloud sweep name every copy a refresh would change, and the controller opens the refresh that session without asking.
follows.owner: Only the owner can change it; agents find what is out of step and name the exact step for the owner's one yes.
follows.plugin: Delivered by the installed Toolkit at session start; the repository holds no copy.
follows.auto: Toolkit's own agents and scripts keep it current with no owner step.

parts.part: Rendered workflow copies: the programme sweep and its gate, and the test shards and Shard Timings copies where parallel CI shards are answered yes
parts.how: Each copy checks out Toolkit main (or the TOOLKIT_REF pin) at run time; a layout change, an action pin, the CI workflow the gate follows or the shard ids reach it through the refresh pull request.

parts.part: Copied files: the personal data guard (its check and sweep workflows, its script, and its settings while missing) and the dependency auto-merge workflow
parts.how: Copied as they are, so every Toolkit change to them makes the copy older; missing, edited or older copies are named at session start and by the cloud sweep. The guard's settings file is the owner's once it exists.

parts.part: Plain-text check: the vendored check script, its settings, its baseline and its workflow
parts.how: The vendored script and an old-format baseline change only through the refresh pull request, and an older script is named at session start and by the cloud sweep. The settings stay the owner's; the workflow file is written once when absent and not compared.

parts.part: Programme binding (.github/toolkit-programme.json) and the governance state it decides
parts.how: Changed only by governance pull requests the owner merges. A key a newer Toolkit adds reads as its default until then, so a release never needs a binding change; a new owner choice shows in the governance question bank.

parts.part: Repository rules and settings: the no-force-push ruleset, merge commits only, required checks equal to the binding and pinned, up to date before merging, and the dependency and security settings
parts.how: The once-a-day background read (toolkit-governance-parts.cjs) reads them as the governance check does and names drift at session start with the exact step; `toolkit governance migrate` (the owner's Enter) and `toolkit governance security` fix it after the owner's one yes.

parts.part: Instruction files: AGENTS.md, the CLAUDE.md shim and the governed rules
parts.how: The governed rules come from the installed Toolkit at session start; a leftover copy in AGENTS.md is named and removed by pull request on the owner's answer.

parts.part: Sweep pin: the repository's TOOLKIT_REF variable
parts.how: The owner's stop switch: unset means Toolkit main; a takeover names a pin.

parts.part: Governance App: its variable and secret on the repository
parts.how: A new App permission needs the owner's accept on GitHub; a missing or partly set up App is named at session start from the background read.

parts.part: Evidence store contents: programme state documents, handover files and controller settings
parts.how: Written by Toolkit scripts with schema versions; readers come before writers.

parts.part: Shard list and timings (.github/toolkit-test-shards.json)
parts.how: A weekly bot pull request refreshes the timings where shards apply.

parts.part: Managed Toolkit checkout, bridge and Claude Code CLI plugin
parts.how: Fast-forwarded at every session start (Repo-Backed Auto-Update in TOOLKIT-LOCAL-BRIDGE.md).

parts.part: The claude.ai account copy of Toolkit (desktop chats, Projects, cloud)
parts.how: The owner refreshes it; the desktop session start names its version and the Projects check-in says when it is behind.

parts.part: Toolkit permission lines in each app's settings
parts.how: An agent never widens its own permissions; session start and turn end name missing or old lines and `toolkit permissions` gives the one command.

parts.part: The session's own checkout of the governed repository
parts.how: Fast-forwarded to origin's default branch at session start (toolkit-repo-catchup.cjs).

parts.part: Antigravity skill copies
parts.how: Copied at session start.

parts.part: Controller memory
parts.how: Not Toolkit's; restated Toolkit defaults are tidied by the memory tidy tool on the owner's word.

parts.part: Guidebook copy (the project library copy of the Projects skill)
parts.how: The hourly nudge and the daily check-in refresh it from a fresh clone.

parts.part: Managed project-instructions block
parts.how: Applied by the coordinator with a saved copy and read-back when it is outdated or changed.

parts.part: Project memory lines (binding, scheduled tasks, gate route)
parts.how: Checked and rewritten by the check-in when their format or binding is stale.

parts.part: Toolkit scheduled tasks (daily check-in, hourly nudge)
parts.how: Their checklists are read from the guidebook copy; the daily check-in plans, swaps and reads back every outdated task.

parts.part: The owner's own Projects tasks on the Toolkit shell
parts.how: Each run expands its steps from main; a shell change is swapped by the daily check-in with the takeover's read-back, never touching a stopped task (INT-TK421-1378).

parts.part: Project tasks without the shell, and local or device tasks
parts.how: Not Toolkit's: advice only.

parts.part: The saved claude.ai copy of the Projects skill
parts.how: Only the owner can accept its card; it stays with the account-copy refresh (INT-TK421-1378).

parts.part: Other projects' Toolkit tasks
parts.how: Reported only; each project's own check-in swaps its own tasks.
